references.label: GAIB sAID documentation: floating-NAV ERC-4626 vault share

applicabilityBasis.summary: sAID is an ERC-4626 strategy-vault share representing a proportional interest in AI infrastructure financing. Product documentation explicitly states that sAID is not pegged to USD 1.00 and floats with portfolio NAV, earned yield and losses. The resulting AID exit amount depends on the vault conversion rate, rather than a fixed monetary redemption promise. This supports non-payment-token applicability assessed independently of underlying AID.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07 independently from underlying AID. Product documentation establishes a floating-NAV, yield-accruing ERC-4626 strategy-vault share. GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization, issuer pathway, foreign exception and DASP offer/sale fields are therefore not applicable to this share assessment. Product documentation names a Spiceflow vault operator; platform terms identify technology and strategy-management roles, but do not establish the token legal issuer, so issuerEntity and domicile are omitted. Product docs describe monthly withdrawal cohorts, while the current independently reviewed base-file notice records live request-relative 30-day cooldown and FIFO processing subject to liquidity; this compliance row makes no claim resolving that operational difference. The linked strategy memorandum landing page was reopened but did not expose readable document text, and is not used as classification evidence. This assessment does not purport to determine securities-law status.
